baseline.answer: Pack: five columns on iPhone; one Item Category at a time, selected through category icons. Artwork and key properties are visible; Item names appear only on selection.

Card signals: Unknown (the earlier New label is the same mechanic), category/class, Identification state, and the same category-specific property on every identified Item within its category. The actual category-to-property mapping is unresolved; “highest stat” was superseded.

Inspection: open and close each Item individually. Nearly full-width panel with narrow side margins. Artwork left; name and identifying details right. Reuse the Pack card with badges and property strip.

Art: original EarthNova artwork applying the reference’s iconography principles. Exaggerate real distinguishing features for recognition; no invented scientific traits. Stat icons are shaded miniature objects with highlights and outlines.

Motion: subtle Item idle animation (animals breathe, plants sway, highlights shimmer). Input interrupts presentation immediately. Button press moves the button down and removes its shadow; release returns quickly and smoothly without overshoot.
Sound: gameplay outcomes only when enabled—acquisition, Identification, Encounter results.
Main navigation: icons only, with a Help control that temporarily labels all icons. Accessible names remain required.
Encounters: mark on Map and let the Player open them; no automatic interruption.
Unavailable actions remain visible, look unavailable, and explain why when tapped.
First Discovery: same Identification reveal, plus a small first-Discovery badge; no extra celebration screen.
Surfaces: subtle texture noticeable only on close inspection; deep forest green direction; strong sculpted bevels; small rounded corners; thin dark outlines.
Inspection: strong soft outer shadow; heavily dimmed but recognizable backdrop. Keep a relevant background resource counter bright when an action has a resource cost.
Close control: dark × directly on the panel, with no visible button frame. Check contrast and retain a generous tap target.

Item-name typography: rounded and slightly playful; extra-bold; clearly visible dark outline; warm cream role. Starts around twice the stat-value size, never wraps, and keeps shrinking until the complete name fits, even below a normal minimum. This is an explicitly accepted readability tradeoff, not an accidental implementation fallback.
Stat labels: emphasis role (gold direction) distinct from cream-value role. Labels above bars, aligned with the value area.
Stats: three columns, continuing onto more rows; dark inset bars with small rounded corners; large icons overlap the left edge; values centered in the remaining space.

Description/effects: one shared dark inset panel. Headings and key numbers use the emphasis role; body text uses the primary-text role. Bold throughout. Tight spacing within sections, generous gaps between them.
Effects: small round bullets; recurring property/effect names replaced by inline icons slightly taller than surrounding letters.
Help: a panel-level information button opens a symbol legend. Raised circular information-role button (blue direction) with cream “i,” overlapping the panel’s upper-right border.
Progress bars: wide shallow rectangles, small rounded corners, centered numbers, glossy fill with bright upper edge. Resource icon overlaps the left end.
Outcome preview: separate raised panel with beveled edges, only for an already-defined action outcome.
Main action buttons: strong bevels, thick lower edge; extra-bold rounded outlined labels. Unavailable state uses a neutral face and muted lettering while retaining bevels.
Costs: inside the action button below its name, text roughly two-thirds the action-name size; resource icon follows the amount.
Two actions: equal-width buttons side by side. A known reward appears directly below its associated button.
Pack title: illustrated ribbon with folded ends, roughly half the screen width; light surface and dark text roles; clean smooth edges without wear. Bold rounded lettering without a prominent outline.

Palette instruction supersedes independent component color picking: resolve all colors through EarthNova’s design-system palette and semantic roles. Forest green, cream, gold, blue, neutral, outline, shadow, and state choices are role directions, not hard-coded hex values.

The skipped toolbar and search-field choices were subsequently resolved by the accepted visual and interaction rules; group visible search/sort/filter controls and use the light reference search field.
baseline.source_answer: Toolbar arrangement was skipped and remains open. Search-field contrast was asked but not answered.

direction.answer: Existing artwork is replaceable wherever clarity improves. No legacy-art preservation constraint; use original assets and a documented art brief
Judge visuals and interactions in a real Flutter build on an actual iPhone. Review actual shared production widgets; screenshots and workbench emulation alone cannot certify touch or performance
Jeremy approves representative art, then reviews exceptions afterward. Record approved exemplars and objective checks; routine assets need not wait for individual preapproval
No players yet; build the right thing. No customer migration cohorts or rollout optimization; retain correctness and data boundaries
Conservationist, science, technology meets nature. Shared visual vocabulary for materials, equipment, symbols, and copy
Contemporary baseline with tasteful, occasional humorous/ironic sci-fi that stays out of the way. Refines earlier optimistic near-future choice; no medieval fantasy or pervasive futuristic chrome
Clear game interface with conservation-tech styling. No literal field-device frame around the app
Slightly expressive animal eyes and poses without cartoon characters. Preserve scientifically identifying features; no invented human traits that obscure species recognition
Individual Item properties do not change artwork. Art keyed to stable Base Item plus art revision/size variant; differences shown through properties/badges
Wider devices use available width with comfortable controls/text. Additional columns/layout space rather than a centered phone-shaped app or indiscriminate scaling
Almost all presentation derives from a common system. Tokens, materials, behaviors, assets, components, patterns, registry and evidence form one enforced foundation
Shadcn is the default; EarthNova overrides it. Keep the existing `shadcn_ui` dependency and root; adapt shared overrides rather than introducing a competing UI kit
